title: Pick the right model setting
intro: Pick what you want and see the command that does it.

inputs.label: You want
options: Switch to Opus for a hard bug
Plan with Opus, code with Sonnet
Use a model your admin didn't allow

when.equals: Switch to Opus for a hard bug

show.title: Use /model opus
show.detail: The alias points to the newest Opus, so you don't need the exact version name.

trace.text: Switches the session to the latest Opus.

show.title: Raise the effort
show.detail: A higher effort level spends more time and tokens on reasoning for better results on tough problems.

trace.text: Uses high effort from the next reply.

when.equals: Plan with Opus, code with Sonnet

show.title: Use the opusplan alias
show.detail: opusplan runs Opus while in plan mode and Sonnet for the work afterwards.

when.equals: Use a model your admin didn't allow

show.title: Not available
show.detail: When availableModels is set in managed settings, models outside that list can't be chosen.

trace.text: The model isn't in your organization's allowed list.

fallback.title: Pick an option
fallback.detail: Choose one of the options to see what happens.

quiz.question: Why use an alias like sonnet instead of a full model ID?
options: Aliases follow the newest version automatically
quiz.explanation: Aliases resolve to the latest version of that model family for your provider.
